# Nail Studio

> Manicure, pedicure and hand-painted nail art in Gadsden, Alabama. A quiet studio practising a slower kind of beauty.

## About

Nail Studio is a locally owned nail salon located in Gadsden, Alabama at the Gadsden Mall. We specialise in manicures, pedicures, and custom hand-painted nail art. Every service begins with a conversation and is performed by experienced technicians who work to strict hygiene standards. We also offer event services for birthdays, bridal parties, baby showers, and graduations.

## Services

- **Manicure** — Shaped, softened and finished by hand. Uses paraffin wax, oils and lotions to exfoliate the skin, moisturise the cuticles and soften the nails. Range of styles available.
- **Pedicure** — A reset for the ground you walk on. Addresses ingrown and brittle nails, helps prevent build-up of germs with thoroughly cleaned and sterile tools. Range of pedicure styles to keep feet healthy and comfortable.
- **Nail Art** — A small canvas, taken seriously. Painted, sculpted and finished by hand. From a single accent to a full set, our technicians work with your ideas and a wide range of styles.
- **Events** — Private bookings for birthdays, bridal parties, baby showers and graduations.
